FAIL_TO_PASS: bundle-error: recovers from errors during bundling
context: Uses --context to set `this` value
property-read-side-effects: allows disabling side-effects when accessing properties
advanced-esm: load an ESM-only rollup plugin from node_modules as well as CJS plugins
config-cjs-dirname: does not transpile cjs configs and provides correct __filename
config-mjs-plugins: supports native esm as well as CJS plugins when using .mjs in Node 13+
force-exit: force exits even with open handles
warn-eval-multiple: warns when eval is used multiple times
code-splitting-named-inputs: allows defining names via CLI
warn-this: warns "this" is used on the top level
module-name: generates UMD export with correct name
multiple-targets: generates multiple output files when multiple targets are specified
warn-unknown-options: warns about unknown CLI options
empty-chunk: shows warning when chunk empty
relative-esm: ESM CLI --plugin ../relative/path
config-function-modify-command: allows cleaning up and modifying the command args in the config file
warn-mixed-exports-multiple: warns when mixed exports are used
with-dash: stdin input with dash on CLI
object: CLI --plugin object
config-json: allows config file to import json
